name: status-indicator
summary: Pairs a compact semantic status marker with explicit text and optional detail.

agent.useWhen: A compact row, header, or metadata value needs an explicit current state; provide visible status text and choose a semantic tone, optional detail, size, and pulse.
agent.avoidWhen: The message needs explanation, recovery guidance, a live announcement, or a pill-shaped category; use an alert or badge instead.

invariants: Configuration supplies tone, size and pulse; label and detail are app-owned presentation data, currently literal-only in Native declarations.
The component owns no Datastar signal, event output, command or browser lifecycle; the app decides when data changes and which region is patched.
A visible nonblank label always communicates status in text; color is never the only signal.
The dot is decorative and hidden from assistive technology; the component does not create a live region or announce changes.
Detail is optional supporting visible text and must be nonblank when provided.
Pulse is a visual treatment for genuinely active states only and is disabled under reduced-motion preferences.
The fragment has exactly one [[attributes]], [[label]], and [[detail]] slot; the catalog renderer escapes text and expands absent detail to an empty string.
The component is static and noninteractive; it adds no keyboard behavior or JavaScript.
